The 2026 Memorial Day sales at Amazon and Best Buy are in full swing and today’s 9to5Toys Lunch Break is headlined by AirPods Pro 3 dropping down to one of the best prices yet at $199. We also have this 14-inch 24GB M5 MacBook Pro with the 96W Apple charger at $320 off today ($420 off the launch price) this black Apple Watch Ultra 2 is $380 ($419 off the list price, refurb) and Series 11 from $299. Just be sure to also scope out Satechi’s new Space Black metal 25W 3-in-1 MagSafe stand back to best price yet and the now live Nintendo Switch 2: Choose Your Game console bundle deal – this might be the best deal we get all year on Switch 2. Head below for a closer look.

AirPods Pro 3 just dropped down to one of the best prices yet at $199 for Memorial Day

As part of its now live 2026 Memorial Day sale, Amazon is offering one of the best prices to date on the AirPods Pro 3 down at $199 shipped. 

Amazon has Apple’s latest and greatest AirPods Pro 3 on sale down at $199 shipped as of this morning.

  • AirPods Pro 3 $199 (Reg. $249)
  • AirPods 4 $99 (Reg. $129)
  • AirPods Max 2 $509 (Reg. $549) – Amazon all-time low

Regularly $249, this is a straight up 20% off the list price and the best deal as can find on what are arguably the best earbuds you can buy.

Amazon and several other retailers had Apple’s flagship buds down at $200 off and on since early/mid April as part of spring sale events, but they are now down an additional $1 here today to deliver one of the lowest prices of the year.

This offer lands on par with the best price we have ever tracked on Amazon outside of an extremely short-lived offer at $184. This was essentially Amazon price matching an already tough to get offer from Verizon back in early February – this price match was indeed available for purchase but it was unstable, short-lived, and not very many folks even had a chance to pull the trigger as it kept going in and out of stock or jumping back up in price to $230 or so.

As you can see above, today’s AirPods Pro 3 land alongside a chance to score AirPods 4 down at $99 and the ongoing Amazon all-time low on the new AirPods Max 2. While we would of course prefer to see the AirPods 4 down closer to $79 or $89 at this point, there are still some colors on the brand new AirPods Max 2 sitting at the best price we have tracked on Amazon to date (or anywhere else in bran new condition).

The Amazon 2026 Memorial Day sale is now in full swing and it is clearly starting to add more deals to the sale as AirPods Pro 3 land back to one of the lowest prices to date here this morning. Stay locked to 9to5Toys as we uncover new deals right through the week, this weekend, and into Memorial Day proper come Monday.

This 14-inch 24GB M5 MacBook Pro w/ 96W Apple charger is $320 off today ($420 off launch price)

While there are plenty of notable discounts flying on the M5 and 2026 M5 Pro MacBook Pro lineup at Amazon right now, B&H is landing this morning with another special bundle offer. This 24GB M5 MacBook Pro with the upgraded 96W Apple charger is $320 off right now ($420 off its launch price).

B&H is offering the 14-inch M5 MacBook Pro with 24GB of RAM and the 1TB internal SSD down at $1,599 shipped.

This is a regularly $1,899 configuration, but B&H is also throwing in the upgraded 96W USB-C Power Adapter instead of the regular 70W model you’ll get in the box standard. Configuring this same machine with the 96W wall charger at Apple adds an additional $20 to the price:

  • 14-inch M5 MacBook Pro 24GB/1TB $1,599 (Reg. $1,919)
  • With Apple 96W USB-C Power Adapter

Today’s deal is $320 off the list price and the best deal we can find. Amazon is charging $1,749 for this same machine right now with the standard 70W charger, and it has never sold for less than $1,699 there – today’s B&H offer is a very good one for this particular configuration.

This setup originally launched in late 2025 at $1,999 and it is now $420 less than that. However, after Apple nixed the 512GB storage tier the price effectively dropped to the $1,899 (or $1,919 with the 96W charger) we have now.

This black Apple Watch Ultra 2 is $380 today ($419 off the list price, Refurb), or Series 11 from $299

As part of today’s Grade A iPhones & Watches Apple sale at Woot, and alongside today’s price drop on AirPods Pro 3, it is offering some compelling refurbished discounts on a range of handset and smartwatches. One that caught our eye is this deal on the black Apple Watch Ultra 2 at $419 off the original list price.

We have seen Amazon Premium Renewed and excellent refurb units in the $409 to $420 range a few times this year, but Woot is now offering the Black Titanium Apple Watch Ultra 2 in “Grade A” Refurbished condition down at $379.99 shipped today. It ships with a 1-year Woot warranty.

Original $799 before it was replaced by Apple Watch Ultra 3 back in September, this is $419 off the list and the lowest price we can find from a reputable source.

Best Buy is offering brand new condition black Apple Watch Ultra 2 units down at $549 right now, or $250 off the original list, which is a notable deal, but when it comes to landing the lowest possible price right now with a 1-year warranty, this Woot deal is worth a look.

Just for comparison sake, Amazon is charging $776 for the most comparable Apple Watch Ultra 3 model right now. The black series 3 variant with the matching black Ocean Band has never sold for less than $699 there since release in September.

If you would prefer to go with a brand Series 11 Apple wearable instead, there are some notable deals still live as part of Amazon’s Memorial Day sale right now at up to $130 off on the most affordable models:

  • 42mm Apple Watch Series 11 $299 (Reg. $399)
  • 46mm Apple Watch Series 11 $329 (Reg. $429)
  • 42mm Apple Watch Series 11 GPS + Cell $399 (Reg. $499)
  • 46mm Apple Watch Series 11 GPS + Cell $399 (Reg. $529)

Amazon has Apple’s most affordable current-gen iPad back down at $299 today (All colors)

Joining its now live Memorial Day sale, Amazon is giving folks another short to score the most affordable current-generation iPad there is down at $299. We have some particularly notable deals on the latest M4 iPad Air right now at up to $150 off, but for more casual users the iPad 11 is a far less pricey proposition.

The M4 iPad Air deals we have right now are solid for sure, with several of the lighter storage capacity models back down at the lowest prices we have tracked to date. You’ll find models starting from $520 right now:

  • 11-inch M4 iPad Air 128GB $520 (Reg. $599)
  • 11-inch M4 iPad Air 256GB $610 (Reg. $699)
  • 13-inch M4 iPad Air 256GB $790 (Reg.$899)

Nice, but still not nearly as affordable as the latest 11-inch iPad (A16) starting down at $299 shipped in all four colors.

Clearly the M4-equipped iPad Air is a far more powerful machine, a newer release, and one I feel is the best option in the lineup for most folks. But if you’re just a super casual user, or perhaps just looking for an extra Apple tablet, something the whole family can get a hold of without spending a fortune, I still think the iPad 11 is a great option for light browsing, video chat, and that sort of thing.

Regularly $349, today’s deal lands the base model back at the lowest we have tracked this year ahead of Memorial Day 2026, and comes within $25 or so of the Amazon low.

New M4 iPad Air all-time lows are back: Most affordable 11-inch at $80 off, 256GB 13-inch at $110 off

Apple’s most affordable new M4 iPad Air has now dropped back down to the lowest price we have tracked to date at $520. We are also tracking the 11-inch 256GB at $90 off the 13-inch 256GB back at the all-time low with $110 in savings.

Amazon is now offering the 128GB 11-inch M4 iPad Air down at $519.99 shipped. This is a regularly $599 configuration, the least expensive model you can buy, and the lowest price we can find.

We saw this same deal go live nearer the top of the month before jumping back up to $560 or so, but it has now returned to deliver the second chance at the Amazon all-time low pricing.

Much like just about all iPad configurations in recent years, the more pricey upgraded models tend to see the deepest discounts. So while the $80 off here might not seem like a ton, this is indeed a solid discount and on par with the best we have tracked yet.

Today’s deal, unlike most of the storage capacities, is landing in equal measure across all four colors – all of them are now back at the lowest we have seen to date.

There are a couple upgraded models back at all-time low prices as well – these are the two highlights:

  • 11-inch M4 iPad Air 128GB $520 (Reg. $599)
  • 11-inch M4 iPad Air 256GB $610 (Reg. $699)
  • 13-inch M4 iPad Air 256GB $790 (Reg.$899)

While the 128GB might leaving something to be desired for some folks, I tend to think these more affordable storage options deliver the best bang for the buck when it comes to most users. I mean, I guess some folks actually need more storage on an iPad, and I favor/can certainly appreciate one of the more mid-range options, but I certainly don’t need anything more than this personally.
